asset: Hokkaido v23 separate original high-poly clay bear/salmon prototype
reviewer: ChatGPT direct visual inspection of real Blender Cycles 4-view GLB image, compared to actual v22 Cycles image; additional trimesh mesh diagnostics

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Clean compact mass but still leg-and-body junctions look like flattened cylinders; silhouettes are less anatomically convincing than v22.

face_and_expression.reason: Tiny triangle nose and carved eye sockets; overall face is round toy-like and ears are applied-looking.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: Visible lower rim below fish in front view but no genuine legible bite; fish remains a long paddle/plank in silhouette.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: Intentionally matte clay to isolate geometry, not a final wood sculpt; final carving quality cannot pass yet.

paws_and_limbs.reason: All four limbs look like blocky boot cylinders with no articulated toes, tendon-to-paw transitions or claws.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Actual 4-angle Cycles renders from reproducible 12-mesh GLB; detailed provenance and hash retained.

defects.finding: Fish still lies across the bear's snout; actual 3D cross sections do not guarantee recognizable upper/lower mouth contact.
defects.required_fix: Introduce consistent lateral fish-head silhouette and reposition inner mouth opening so upper and lower carved muzzle surround fish section visibly from side/front.

defects.finding: Fore/hind legs and foot bottoms are thick vertical extrusions; polished clay makes primitive construction obvious.
defects.required_fix: Reference-lock ankle/knuckle/toe silhouette and keep paws unified with legs during remesh.

defects.finding: GLB main bear mesh is not watertight in trimesh (raw and vertex-welded), and decomposes into three connected components despite being labelled one connected high-poly form.
defects.required_fix: Repair boolean/voxel remesh mesh integrity and recheck actual output topology before texture baking.

defects.finding: Fish crosswise body remains visually straight, flat and thin in front view; fins are simplistic blades.
defects.required_fix: Use stronger asymmetrical bent centerline, enlarged head/gill landmark and tapered three-dimensional peduncle/tail.

diagnostics.tool_note: Trimesh GLB main bear geometry reports is_watertight=False; welded copy still false. These are geometry integrity warnings, not an artistic test.

improvement_tasks: DO NOT promote v23 over v22; independent new workflow is technically operable but artistic/mesh QA fail.
Preserve first v23 output as audit baseline. Build a second candidate only after repairing mesh integrity and fish/feet shape.
No external copyrighted mesh was cloned; reference photos used only for study.
